title_en: Stories of Modern China (9/20): The Teacher Who Wouldn't Give Up
note_en: 反而 (fǎn'ér) signals that the result is the opposite of what you'd expect: 她没有放弃，反而更加用心地备课 "she didn't give up; instead, she put even more care into her lessons." It's stronger than 但是 "but": closer to English "on the contrary" or "if anything," and it goes before the verb, not at the start of the clause.
